campaign.name: Parent Acquisition
campaign.objective: Introduce local families to the centre and invite them to a free first lesson.

concepts.name: Academic Excellence
concepts.strategy: Show ambitious families a focused, supportive place to build strong academic foundations.
concepts.audience: Parents of children aged 5–16 around Edgbaston.
concepts.proposition: High expectations, clear teaching and individual attention.

ads.primary_text: Help your child build knowledge, confidence and good study habits. Discover small-group tuition at Edgbaston Tuition Centre. Book a free first lesson and meet our tutors.
ads.headline: Academic Excellence Starts Here.
ads.creative_alt: Academic Excellence campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

ads.primary_text: A little focused support can make learning feel different. Explore Maths, English and Science tuition for primary-age children in a welcoming local centre.
ads.headline: Stronger foundations. Greater confidence.
ads.description: Find the right support for your child
ads.creative_alt: Academic Excellence campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

ads.primary_text: From understanding a topic to applying it in an exam: our tutors guide students through each step. Try a free GCSE Maths lesson at Edgbaston Tuition Centre.
ads.headline: A clearer path through GCSE Maths.
ads.creative_alt: Academic Excellence campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

concepts.name: Learning How to Learn
concepts.strategy: Explain the teaching approach through understanding, practice and useful learning habits.
concepts.audience: Parents who want their child to become a more confident, independent learner.
concepts.proposition: Build the skills behind better learning.

ads.primary_text: Understanding a topic is only the beginning. We help students practise, ask questions and build habits they can use beyond the classroom. Experience our approach in a free first lesson.
ads.headline: Don’t just study harder. Learn better.
ads.description: Discover a structured approach to learning
ads.creative_alt: Learning How to Learn campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

ads.primary_text: Learning grows when children feel comfortable asking for help. Our small groups give students space to ask questions and work through topics with a tutor.
ads.headline: Make room for the questions.
ads.creative_alt: Learning How to Learn campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

ads.primary_text: Give your child a structured place to learn, with focused teaching and time to practise. Explore tuition at Edgbaston Tuition Centre.
ads.headline: Understand. Practise. Build confidence.
ads.creative_alt: Learning How to Learn campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

concepts.name: Results & Proof
concepts.strategy: Show the learning environment now. Add specific results or testimonials only after the client supplies and verifies them.
concepts.audience: Parents looking for credible evidence of the centre’s approach.
concepts.proposition: See the support behind a student’s progress.

ads.primary_text: Meet the tutors, see the classroom and experience a lesson. A free first visit is a simple way to explore whether our centre is right for your child.
ads.headline: See the support behind the progress.
ads.creative_alt: Results & Proof campaign photograph of learning at Edgbaston Tuition Centre

ads.primary_text: Get to know the environment where your child could learn. Visit Edgbaston Tuition Centre for a free first lesson and talk to us about their goals.
ads.headline: A place to focus. People to help.

ads.primary_text: Every learner arrives with different questions and goals. Talk to our team about the support available, then try a lesson for yourself.

concepts.strategy: Make the next step simple: experience the centre before choosing a programme.

concepts.proposition: Try a lesson and meet the people who will support your child.
